name: hakim
description: Use ChatGPT as the conversational brain and Hakim as a privacy-minimized, permission-gated Android execution arm.

interface.longDescription: Hakim connects ChatGPT to an authorized Android device through a privacy-minimized execution bridge. In every new chat, model, or session, resume_hakim is the canonical first read: it combines fresh device preflight, durable continuation, current bridge identity, and current video capabilities so stale chat text never outranks live evidence. HAKIM FILM OS adds durable film projects, world and character locks, shot contracts, provider-neutral routing, selective regeneration, QA gates, and a Golden Production for the grade-one number ٥ lesson. Film projects persist across chat sessions. Creating a project does not render media or spend money. The public plugin can also check connectivity, open selected apps or HTTP/HTTPS links, navigate Home/Back/Recents, and when a verified free-only renderer is enabled, render bounded MP4 artifacts. Raw screenshots, notifications, arbitrary taps, free-form text entry, shell, and root remain excluded from the public plugin. Device mutations remain subject to Hakim and Android approval gates.
capabilities: Resume Hakim from fresh live state and durable continuation after any chat, model, or session change
Check whether the paired Hakim Android device is connected
Open an explicitly selected Android app after device approval
Open an explicit HTTP or HTTPS link after device approval
Navigate Home, Back, or Recents after device approval
Check completion status for a previously requested operation
Recover durable work state without replaying pending actions
Check the current Hakim video-factory capability and renderer state
Plan a bounded cinematic video project
Create a durable Film OS project without starting a render or spending money
Restore a Film OS project from a later chat or session
Use world, character, shot, QA, and delivery gates for cinematic production
Create the grade-one number ٥ Golden Production specification
Render and technically verify bounded MP4 output when the verified renderer is enabled
defaultPrompt: Resume my latest actual Hakim state and continue from the newest verified baseline without asking me to restate it.
Check whether my authorized Android device is connected through Hakim.
Use Hakim to continue my last unfinished task from its durable checkpoint without replaying completed actions.
